en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hussain from his father from Abi Basir from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said:
Whoever recites it in his obligatory and recommended prayers, it would be said to him on the Day of Judgment: Enter Paradise from whichever door you like.
